_comment: Fixed (NOT rolling) wall-clock reference for the non-blocking perf alert (#60). A rolling baseline ratchets: a sequence of 3% regressions each passes against its predecessor. The reference MUST be measured on CI hardware (ubuntu-latest), not a maintainer's machine, so best_ns ships null and is seeded by dispatching the Perf Reference workflow on main. An intentional, accepted slowdown is recorded by re-running that dispatch, so drift shows up as a reviewable diff to this file. threshold_pct sits well above the 6-19% best-of-5 spread measured locally so only sustained real regressions alert (and the alert is non-blocking regardless).
